opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based at a UK institution; individuals without a formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution are not eligible. Projects led by UK organisations are required.
opportunities.summary: The Main Grants fund offers up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Nuffield Foundation's Strategic Review, focusing on relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience, and value for money.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund (RDUK)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, especially from racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications involving UK research organisations.
opportunities.summary: The Racial Diversity UK Fund supports research on racial diversity within the UK, offering grants from £15,000 to £500,000 to address the 2026 priority theme of inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK.
